name: SDN Record Retention
description: Keeps a rolling window of records on the node (default 72 hours) and deletes what falls out of it (typed contracts 1.0). Each target names a standard and its lane (provider and/or sources); the node's storage.expire host op (SDS $PIV: StorageExpireParams -> StorageExpireResult) deletes the lane's records that arrived on the node more than window_hours ago, paging the store's record index. Each lane pass is reported as a FlowNotice (FNTC): Expired (COUNT deleted, SCHEMA / PROVIDER_ID / SOURCE_NAME, AT_MS the cutoff), Missing (records the index listed that were no longer stored) or Skipped (max_deletes spent). Node CONFIG through plugin.getConfig (one ModuleConfig, read by dotted path): window_hours, batch, max_deletes, targets.<i>.schema / provider_id / sources.<j>. Default target: WXF from provider noaa-ncep. Owner 2026-10-12: a rolling 3-day window on the weather node, configurable, never an archive. No JSON.

externalInterfaces.description: storage.expire: delete one lane's records older than a cutoff, through the store's record index (sdn-server internal/storage/record_expiry.go).

acceptedTypeSets.description: TimerTick (module-sdk runtime type TICK); its payload is not read.

inputPorts.description: Cron timer tick (flows/record-retention.flow.json); a direct invoke needs none.

outputPorts.description: One FlowNotice per lane pass: Expired (COUNT records deleted, SCHEMA / PROVIDER_ID / SOURCE_NAME the lane, AT_MS the cutoff, REASON the window and whether max_deletes capped it); Missing (COUNT records the index listed that were no longer stored, only when any); Skipped (a lane not visited because the pass's max_deletes was spent).

methods.description: Deletes every configured target's records older than now (clock.now) minus window_hours (node config; compiled default 72 h over WXF from provider noaa-ncep), at most max_deletes a pass, through the node's storage.expire, and reports each lane as a FlowNotice.
